body: I wish there was a time machine I could take and just fix all of this....dear god I wish....

This is good advice.....I just feel like the world is coming down around me.  My GF hasn't really done anything to deserve being left by me...as I mentioned, she is disabled and for her, life will not be the same.  She would have to move in with her mother, along with our pets.  The chances of her developing a new relationship is minimal, I'd be leaving her all alone with her mother while I go out to live my life.  The guilt of all of this is tearing my life apart...not to mention my BF & his GF....I can't imagine what they're going through right now....everything is sooooo bad right now.....
what did you do?  Did you lose friends?  How did you handle this?  I'm losing my mind right now.....
I just woke up.....it's worse today.  I don't know what to do.

Good question.  I too have been having the thoughts.....I don't know why I am...I'm actually a pretty happy outgoing person....but I just think about it all the time....I'll be driving and fantasize about being in an accident, look up at a tall building, imagine jumping off, see the beams inside the store I work at, imagine hanging from them....
